Verbalis · Meridian Parallel / Local-first CAT tool

Cyan connects source and target segments. Geist UI and mono terminology metadata support dense work. Solid editor cells; glass only in peripheral controls. Preserve the existing V mark, TM and glossary statuses. Local storage and opt-in sync stay explicit.
